list: Official 55 trophies, checked 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (both agree on every name, description and grade)
note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Counts are the PSN-tracked targets shown on PSNProfiles (0/N). hidden is null throughout: PlayStation lists 28 of the 55 as hidden, but neither public list page exposes which ones per trophy, so no per-trophy hidden flag is guessed here. Guides are written in the author's own words; where the game released the same day and no verified step-by-step source exists yet, the guide says so honestly instead of inventing locations or steps.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_reason: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned; it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks on its own — it is the reward for the whole list, not a task by itself. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally cleanup. Tick trophies off in this planner as you go so nothing is left for the last day.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you start the game. No preparation is needed — just follow the mission objectives until the mission-complete screen appears.

Use this planner's roadmap stages as your 100% checklist and finish every stage.

Do not grind all 250 at once; let the count grow during the story and clean up the remainder in Stage 3.

Sample one of everything the game offers: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest, rather than mastering any one of them. Learn one weapon's challenge at a time and return for gold once your aim is steady; this is one of the harder silvers, so leave it for Stage 3.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_reason: A melee drive-by can be attempted any time in free roam; it is a skill stunt, not a one-time event.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock targets down. It pairs with Let's Go Bowling, so visit the Kolt & Associates' alley for that trophy and try this one on the way there or back. Aim for a group, keep the vehicle moving, and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missable_reason: A cumulative money total; laundering can continue any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PlayStation tracks the target as 0–250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean money. Launder steadily as you play rather than hoarding bills for one big wash, and the total will reach $250,000 during cleanup.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missable_reason: A cumulative spending total; shops stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PlayStation tracks the target as 0–100,000. Every purchase counts: weapons, clothes, vehicles, food and anything else the shops sell. Buy what you actually need during the story and the total grows on its own; spend the remainder on the priciest useful gear in Stage 5.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missable_reason: Garage properties are bought with money in free roam; purchases never lock out.
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PlayStation tracks the target as 0–8. Garages cost money, so this trophy is really a savings goal: keep the laundered earnings from Dime on the Dollar and the spending discipline of Treat Yo Self in balance, and buy each garage as you can afford it. The last garage you buy unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missable_reason: Vehicles keep appearing across Leonida and registration can be done any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PlayStation tracks the target as 0–10. Find a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it; repeat with nine more. It pairs with Whip It Good, which asks you to discover 100 vehicles, so register the interesting ones as you discover them and this trophy finishes early.
